data.name: Rikua
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Rikua a cyberpunk roguelite game where insurgent droids have threatened the balance of power in the future of society. You, as a recruit from A.M.S.U., will hunt rogue androids down across different sci-fi environments using a mix of the three gameplay mechanics: fast-paced 3D isometric combat, third-person shooting, and side-scrolling platforming.

A ROGUELITE ADVENTURE

Different from other roguelite games we love and inspire from, in Rikua you must reach the end of the missions to push the story-line forward, earn your medals, and unlock new missions.

Between runs, you will also play small metroidvania adventures - recalls from the past- that show you where Rikua comes from, and the decisions that led her to this place, as a rookie in the Anti-Metal Special Unit (A.M.S.U.).

BECOME THE PERFECT ASSASSIN

Every run in every mission requires different strategies to reach the goal. Sometimes you’ll have the skills enough to reach the end with the weapons you’ve got, but other times you won’t. Thankfully, there are sponsors interested in your cause to offer you cyberpunk enhancements - boons - to make your objectives easier. From throwing grenades to sword-attached dashes, you must pick the right combination for your fighting style to become a better fighter.

If that’s not enough, you must earn credits during the missions to upgrade Rikua’s lives, shields, and weapons, to become faster, deadlier, and eventually the perfect assassin no one can face and survive to tell the tale.

IMPROVE YOUR REALM: CHALLENGES AND UNLOCKABLES

Between fighting in the story-line objectives, Rikua will have her hub and place to take care of. A place where she can rest, practice, and meet friendly androids - each with their own backstory. Some will care for you, but others will challenge you to unique short mini-challenges where you’ll encounter a new set of difficulties and tasks to succeed on. If you do, you will unlock decorations, music boxes, medals, and some cosmetic suits that will make your hub a serene place to rest in. A place you could call your home.

 

WHAT TO EXPECT DURING THE GAMEPLAY?

  • Roguelite Story: A Hades, Dead Cells, Enter, the Gungeon roguelite game. Earn different credits, choose boons, become stronger, unlock weapons, and eventually become unstoppable against any foe.

  • Three Gameplay Mechanics: Switch between Isometric Camera (Hades), Side-Scrolling combat (Contra, Megaman, Ninja Gaiden) and Third-Person shooting (Wild Guns, Gears of War).

  • The First Missions of the Mechanical War: Jump into the first two missions of the Mechanical War. Each one composing up to 2 difficulties and 15 sub-levels each, to earn yourself the medals and pins required to open the third mission of the Mechanical War, and push the story forward.

  • Time and Goal Challenges: Play 8 different time and goal challenges offered by Ezekiel and Data, two Digital Pantones you'll meet on your Hub.

  • Hub-based growth: Unlock statues and decorations after obtaining different rankings from your challenges to make your home prettier by getting better.

  • Metroidvania Adventure: Return to the past for The First Chapter of Rikua’s storyline. A small metroidvania adventure made of three levels to tell the first tale of our main protagonist.

  • Languages: Currently in English and soon expanding to Spanish and others!

data.short_description: A cyberpunk roguelite game blended with three mechanics: 3D isometric combat, third-person shooting, and fast paced action platformer. Enter the missions, erradicate the rogue androids, build yourself stronger, find the truth in this Mechanical War between the humans and the metal.
